ns2:course.label: HDFS Career Planning & Preparation
ns2:course.description: Overview of job opportunities, graduate, and professional school programs that prepare students for careers in health care, counseling, social work, higher education, policymaking and other fields related to Human Development and Family Studies. Examines types of jobs, graduate and professional opportunities and the preparation they require. Students develop personal job, graduate/professional school preparation plans. Approved for S/U grading only.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Human Development & Family St major(s). Not intended for students with Freshman class standing.
